triggers.detailsText: As per the Letter of Intent received from APTRANSCO, the order comprises the supply of 95 units of 50 MVA, 132/33 kV Power Transformers, aggregating 4,750 MVA of transformation capacity, including 50 units under Lot-1 and 45 units under Lot-2, with an aggregate contract value of approximately Rs 523.21 crore, net of GST. This order builds on Atlanta Electricals' existing engagement with APTRANSCO, following the Company's earlier order for the supply of transformers aggregating 3,120 MVA, valued at approximately Rs 270 crore, further strengthening its relationship with one of India's leading state transmission utilities. The addition of this order provides strong revenue visibility and reflecting the growing demand for transmission infrastructure investments across India.

triggers.detailsText: @ ₹200 Lakhs each from 25 prospective resolution applicants (RA), as Returnable Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) towards participation in the resolution process as at 30th Sept, 2026 and as on the date of signing this report, eight participants have withdrawn from process and EMD have been refunded. The company has not recognized claims in respect of Gratuity of ₹125.05 lakhs during the quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026 (Previous quarter and half year ended 30.09.2025 claims for disputed charges for ₹46.97 Lakhs and ₹93.44 Lakhs respectively) made by its subsidiary Simbhaoli Power Private Limited (SPPL) aggregating to B.K. The company has recognized charges and interest amounting to ₹137.40 Lakhs for the quarter and ₹277.94 Lakhs for the half year ended September 30,2026 (₹ 2.10 Lakhs for the previous quarter and ₹ 3 lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2025) recoverable from its subsidiary, Simbhaoli Power Private Limited (SPPL) as more fully described in Note No 13.
